Good day, <[HANDLE_001]:2071423389608254926|Apripex A>!
Hello!

After reviewing your website, I identified several important on-page SEO problems that need attention. The homepage's meta title and description are too long, it uses multiple H1 tags, the heading hierarchy is incorrect, and numerous images lack ALT attributes. Resolving these problems will improve the site's SEO performance, crawlability, and visibility in search results.

I also observed that the website currently gets very little organic traffic, at around 37 visits per month, and its Authority Score is only 8, so there is considerable potential for improvement. By applying the right SEO strategy, optimizing on-page elements, and building quality links, we can raise your search rankings and generate more organic traffic.
Please also review the SEO results I achieved for previous clients.
Please review the attached audit report that I prepared regarding the website's major fixes. Once I begin the job, I will carry out a deep analysis, identify every issue, and prepare an audit report.

Good day, <[HANDLE_001]:2071423389608254926|Apripex A>!
Hello!

I am following up about the website audit report that I sent you.

Each day that your website remains incompletely optimized represents a lost chance to bring in potential customers through Google. I can grow your organic traffic and reinforce your online presence by implementing the appropriate on-page SEO improvements and link-building strategy.

If this interests you, I can also provide a customized SEO strategy covering the priority fixes, how they will be implemented, and the anticipated results.

I have also found multiple opportunities to grow your business. At present, your website ranks for few keywords, has a weak backlink profile, and receives low organic traffic, limiting its search-engine visibility. Your brand also has minimal or no visibility on emerging AI answer and search platforms—including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity—where millions of people now discover and assess businesses. Improving both your SEO and AI visibility can substantially expand your online reach, attract qualified leads, and build long-term brand authority.
